# Great Smile Dental

> > Multi-location dental practice in San Diego and Chula Vista offering comprehensive dental services from routine care to cosmetic dentistry and implants.

Great Smile Dental operates locations in Chula Vista and San Diego, California, led by Dr. Genevieve Abi-Nahed and Dr. Yamil Reeves. The practice specializes in family dentistry, cosmetic procedures, dental implants, and emergency services with a patient-first approach.

## Key Topics

- Dental Implants
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Family Dentistry
- Emergency Dental Care
- Orthodontics
- Dental Crowns
- Dentures
- Oral Hygiene
- Invisalign
- Dr. Genevieve Abi-Nahed
- Dr. Yamil Reeves
- San Diego CA
- Chula Vista CA
- Appointment Scheduling
- Dental Insurance
